ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Figure 5 on the right is a schematic diagram of changes in land use in a certain city. <image1> According to the diagram, the spatial form of the city usually expands along ____; these routes will become the main development axes of the settlement.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In Figure 5 there is a legend, marking land use before 1950, land use after 1960, and land use after 1990. Urban land gradually expands outward from a relatively small central area, and in the later period the area shows a relatively obvious belt-like and axial extension. The figure also marks linear channels such as the canal, the Yangtze River, and the railway, and the direction of urban expansion is generally consistent with these linear channels. Then reason: The question stem says “these routes will become the main development axes of the settlement,” requiring a summary of what routes the urban spatial form expands along. The canal, Yangtze River shipping line, railway, etc. all belong to transportation connection channels, and can be summarized as transportation trunk lines. Therefore “transportation trunk lines” should be filled in.

raw_record.question_text:
Figure 5 on the right is a schematic diagram of changes in land use in a certain city.

<image1>

According to the diagram, the spatial form of the city usually expands along ____; these routes will become the main development axes of the settlement.

method.method_draft: 先读图：图中有1950年前用地、1960年后用地、1990年后用地等范围符号，城市用地由早期小范围逐步向外扩展，扩展后的轮廓呈带状、轴向分布，并与图上的运河、长江、铁路等线状通道方向基本一致。再读题干：空格后说“这些线路会成为聚落的主要发展轴”，要求概括城市空间形态沿什么线路扩展。桥接规则是城市用地若沿河流、铁路、运河等交通线路呈带状延伸，应概括为沿交通干线扩展。因此填“交通干线”。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图5中有图例，标出1950年前用地、1960年后用地、1990年后用地。城市用地从中心较小范围逐渐向外扩展，后期范围呈较明显的带状、轴向延伸。图中还标有运河、长江、铁路等线状通道，城市扩展方向与这些线状通道大体一致。
再推理：题干说“这些线路会成为聚落的主要发展轴”，要求概括城市空间形态沿什么线路扩展。运河、长江航运线、铁路等都属于交通联系通道，可概括为交通干线。因此应填“交通干线”。
